title: OpenAI cannot inspect X and Apple’s confidential antitrust settlement
friendlyTitle: A judge keeps the Apple and X settlement private from OpenAI
summary: A US federal judge denied OpenAI access to the confidential settlement between Apple, X Corp and SpaceXAI, finding it irrelevant to the remaining antitrust case. X and SpaceXAI still allege that Apple’s ChatGPT integration unfairly restricts competition, while Apple says the arrangement is not exclusive.
friendlySummary: OpenAI asked to see Apple’s private settlement with Elon Musk’s companies, but a judge said it was not relevant. A separate case about Apple’s ChatGPT integration will continue.
whyItMatters: The January trial could influence how operating-system owners integrate AI assistants and how easily competing models reach users. For businesses building assistant features, distribution agreements may become as consequential as model quality.
friendlyWhyItMatters: The case may affect whether phone and computer platforms can favour one AI assistant. That can shape which tools customers can easily choose.
